verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਛਿਨ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap chhin siv sanakaadh brahamaadhik na paavahee ||

en.bdb: Even gods like Shiv, Brahma, Sanak etc. are unable to acquire the importance of the congregation that one achieves by keeping the company of the obedient and devoted disciples of the True Guru even for a second.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਉ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਹੂ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: simirat puraan bedh saasatr aau naadh baadh raag raaganee hoo net net kar gaavahee ||

en.bdb: A very short while spent in the holy congregation is sung as infinite, infinite by various religious scriptures like Simritis, Purans, Vedas beside the musical instruments, and various modes of singing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਉ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev sarab nidhaan aau sakal fal savairag samooh sukh dhiaan dhar dhiaavahee ||

en.bdb: All goddesses, gods, treasures, fruits and comforts of heaven sing and remember the peace that they enjoyed even with a fractional association with congregation of the saints.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੪੧॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham satigur saavadhaan jaan gursikh sabadh surat liv laavahee ||341||

en.bdb: The obedient disciples attach their mind and engross themselves in the words of the True Guru with singular mind considering the True Guru to be complete and perfect form of Lord. (341)
